def find_initial_position(n, x):
    # The pattern of swaps repeats every 2 moves
    # 0 <-> 1 on odd moves
    # 1 <-> 2 on even moves
    # We can use this pattern to determine the initial position
    
    # If n is even, the final position is the same as the initial position
    # If n is odd, the final position is the opposite of the initial position
    # This is because the pattern of swaps will reverse the initial position
    
    # Determine the effective number of moves by taking n modulo 2
    effective_moves = n % 2
    
    # Determine the initial position based on the effective moves and the final position
    if effective_moves == 0:
        # If effective_moves is 0, the initial position is the same as the final position
        initial_position = x
    else:
        # If effective_moves is 1, the initial position is the opposite of the final position
        initial_position = 2 - x
    
    return initial_position
